note_en: In 由马云于一九九九年在杭州创办 "founded by Jack Ma in Hangzhou in 1999," 由 (yóu) introduces the person who carries out the action, much like English "by" in a passive. But the verb 创办 stays unchanged: Chinese needs no "was founded" form, and 由 stresses who was responsible, so it is common in formal writing about who founded, organized, or took over something (由张勇接任 "succeeded by Zhang Yong").
